Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
Many thanks for [this payment](../others.html#160), which considering that I had £400 before ought indeed to satisfy me.
I wonder when [Clay](../others.html#173) means to go on with the [Scripture readings](../books.html#87)

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: The final volume of CMY\'s Scripture Readings was not in fact published until 1879, but that this was entirely the printer\'s fault is not certain.
